title: The Internship Opportunity Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Internship roles, qualifications, application windows, and official links. The Internship Opportunity Database lists internships with role descriptions, qualifications, paid-or-unpaid status, application windows, and official application links, verified against the employer's published posting. Records note academic-credit options where offered. The Signature side adds application timelines that work backward from each deadline.
capabilities: Record internships with qualifications and pay status
Track application windows with deadline alerts
Verify listings against official employer postings
Note academic-credit options where offered
Build application timelines from deadlines
